READER REQUESTS

What should we write about next?

Ask for a song to be explained or an artist to be introduced, whether they’re on indiek already or not yet.

The request form needs JavaScript. You can also email gw@lumejs.com.

There’s no contact field, so we can’t reply. Links, email addresses and phone numbers aren’t accepted; please leave out personal details.

Thank you. Your request has reached indiek.

We can’t reply, but a page written in response may mention that readers asked for it, without naming anyone.

How requests work.

A request holds the song or artist you chose and your note, with the time it arrived. Requests are reviewed by indiek and never published as written. Declined requests are deleted within 30 days of review. More on how requests are stored.

For corrections, or anything that needs an answer, email gw@lumejs.com.
